rules: Never use generic Inter for headings.
Overlines MUST be Uppercase + Wide Spacing.

colors.strategy: Electric & Neon crossed with Luxury Dark Mode (Deep Midnight + Yellow)
rules: NO muddy gray transparency. Glassmorphism must be premium.
NEVER use pure #000000. Always tint neutral greys with blue or warm tone (#0A0A0B).
Buttons with --vera-brand must have black text for high contrast.

layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use py-24 or py-32 for sections.

sections.name: Header
sections.style: Sticky Top Nav. Crystal Glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0A0A0B]/80 border-b border-white/10. z-50.

sections.name: Hero
sections.style: min-h-[90vh] flex flex-col justify-center relative. Background image with gradient overlay (bg-gradient-to-r from-[#0A0A0B] via-[#0A0A0B]/80 to-transparent). Content max-w-3xl.

sections.name: Stat Counters
sections.style: grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-8 py-12 border-b border-white/10.

sections.name: Radar / Cartera Activa
sections.style: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6. Filter bar sticky or prominent.

sections.name: Conocé a Sebastián
sections.style: Bento style. grid md:grid-cols-12 gap-12 items-center. Image col-span-12 md:col-span-5, text col-span-12 md:col-span-7.

visual_enhancers.borders: Use Grid Borders micro-theme. 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05).
visual_enhancers.noise: Optional subtle SVG grain overlay for texture to avoid digital flatness.

component_strategies.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full). Primary: bg-[#F6E63A] text-black font-bold hover:scale-105 transition-transform. Secondary: bg-white/5 text-white border border-white/10 backdrop-blur-md.
component_strategies.cards: Property Cards: rounded-2xl overflow-hidden bg-[#121214] border border-white/10 hover:-translate-y-2 transition-transform duration-300.
component_strategies.inputs: Shadcn based. bg-transparent border-white/10 text-white focus:border-[#F6E63A] rounded-xl.

motion.hover: All interactive elements must scale slightly or shift border color.
motion.scroll: Staggered fade-up for grid items. Use framer-motion if possible.
motion.image_hover: Property card images scale-110 on group-hover inside overflow-hidden container.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure #A1A1AA against #0A0A0B passes WCAG. Black text on #F6E63A.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute.

media.icons: lucide-react for standard icons. Phosphor icons if available.

3d_libraries.recommendation: Not strictly needed for this fast coastal UI, but a subtle framer-motion parallax on the hero image or stat counters adds premium feel.

image_urls.description: Picturesque view of house near ocean at sunset
Man with beard and glasses (grayscale with yellow accent glow recommended)

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: NEVER use default Inter or Arial. Stick to the designated fonts (Clash Display / Manrope).
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. generous padding (e.g., py-24).
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Do not use transparent backgrounds for the sticky header; use backdrop-blur and a semi-solid background like bg-[#0A0A0B]/80.
Apply `data-testid` to all CTAs, inputs, and property cards.
WhatsApp buttons are primary CTAs: stylize them distinctively with the Varela Yellow.
The app uses pure CSS variables prefix `vera-`. Map Tailwind utility classes to these variables if possible, or use arbitrary values like `bg-[#F6E63A]`.
instructions_to_main_agent: Create the marketing landing page in React.js (.js files, not .tsx) using Tailwind CSS. Follow the color tokens strictly. Ensure the dark theme has high contrast with the yellow accents. Implement the sections chronologically: Nav, Hero, Stats, Destacados (Radar Inmobiliario), Bio (Conocé a Sebastián), Features (Por qué elegirnos), Portal Promo, Active Listings Grid (Cartera activa), Contact, and Footer. Replicate exact text from requirements (e.g., Sebastián's title, no business hours). Use Lucide-react for icons. The layout MUST feel premium, coastal, and tech-enabled. Focus heavily on layout precision, crisp 1px borders, and responsive mobile design.
